comparison.objective: Route a shore-power cord and insert its plug, versus tune and lock an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable handling and plug insertion versus rigid tool alignment, counterholding, rotary adjustment, locking, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Entire cord must be dry and clear, plug fully seated, then released; candidate requires two compliant impact cycles and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Cable routing and connector insertion do not test dynamic parameter commissioning.
